articles.headline: NBA championship and Finals MVP odds: Thunder remain title favorites heading into Game 7 vs. Spurs
articles.description: Game 7 is set for Saturday in Oklahoma City, with the Thunder-Spurs winner playing the Eastern Conference champion Knicks in the NBA Finals.

images.name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander [1296x729]
images.caption: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and Victor Wembanyama are Nos. 1 and 2 in the Finals MVP odds, respectively.

images.name: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander [608x342]
images.caption: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the Thunder are back to being odds-on title favorites after taking a 3-2 series lead over the Spurs.
images.alt: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander

images.name: Jalen Brunson [608x342]
images.caption: Jalen Brunson has the New York Knicks in the NBA Finals for the first time since 1999.
images.alt: Jalen Brunson

images.name: Knicks/Cavs [1296x729]
images.caption: The Knicks are looking to end the series against the Cavaliers tonight, as they have the second-shortest title odds and are an overwhelming favorite to win the East.
images.alt: New York Knicks guard Landry Shamet (L) defends Cleveland Cavaliers guard Donovan Mitchell (R) during game 3 of the NBA East Conference Finals between the Cleveland Cavaliers and the New York Knicks in Cleveland, Ohio, USA, 23 May 2026.

images.caption: The Knicks are now heavy favorites to win the Eastern Conference after taking a 3-0 series lead over the Cavs.
images.alt: Jalen Brunson
images.credit: Nathaniel S. Butler/NBAE via Getty Images

images.caption: Cade Cunningham and the Pistons are favored heading into Game 7.

article.headline: Harden scores 43 as Clippers rout skidding Wizards 121-96
article.description: — James Harden scored a season-high 43 points in 32 minutes to help the Los Angeles Clippers romp to a 121-96 victory over Washington on Wednesday night, handing the struggling Wizards their 13th consecutive defeat.
article.linkText: Harden scores 43 as Clippers rout skidding Wizards 121-96

images.name: LA Clippers vs. Washington Wizards: Game Highlights
images.caption: LA Clippers vs. Washington Wizards: Game Highlights

article.story: WASHINGTON -- — James Harden scored a season-high 43 points in 32 minutes to help the Los Angeles Clippers romp to a 121-96 victory over Washington on Wednesday night, handing the struggling Wizards their 13th consecutive defeat. Harden hit seven 3-pointers, had 23 points in the first quarter and eclipsed his previous season high of 29 by halftime. The 10-time All-Star posted his highest point total since scoring 44 at Detroit on March 26, 2021, despite exiting the game at the end of the third. Ivica Zubac added 18 points and 16 rebounds for the Clippers, who have won six of seven. It was Los Angeles' second-largest margin of victory this season, after opening a four-game trip with a 26-point win at Philadelphia two games ago. Malcolm Brogdon and Jonas Valanciunas each scored 17 points for Washington, which lost leading scorer Kyle Kuzma to a left rib injury after he played just eight minutes. Takeaways Clippers: Despite a long injury list that's included six-time All-Star Kawhi Leonard (knee) all season, Los Angeles hits the 20-game mark with a 12-8 record. Wizards: Washington is three losses from matching last season's longest skid of 16 straight defeats on the way to a franchise-worst 15-67 record. Key moment The Clippers were in control throughout, but erased any doubt about the outcome when Harden hit 3s on consecutive possessions to stretch the lead to 81-59 with 3:47 left in the third. Key stat Harden's 23-point first quarter marked the ninth time he scored at least 23 in one period, according to StatMuse, and his first since July 31, 2020. Up next The Clippers visit Minnesota on Friday, while the Wizards play Saturday at Milwaukee. ------ AP NBA: https://apnews.com/hub/nba
